case_study_name: New Mexico HPS 2024-2026 official-source workflow profile
description: Case-specific source-role policy overlay for the New Mexico HPS real-source masked-validation workflow profile.
technical_masking_controls: The NMDOH county/year data page is reserved by explicit source_id.
Domain masking remains disabled for this workflow profile; New Mexico masking is source-id based.
Collection uses an explicit source_id allowlist rather than broad search.
Context-only sources may be fetched for grounding but must not produce structured extraction records.
notes: CDC is context/future validation candidate because its current page reports U.S. cumulative through 2023 and does not directly validate New Mexico 2024-2026 annual counts.
NMDOH PDF is held out and manually curated for validation because PDF/OCR is not implemented.
NMDOH HTML press releases are collection sources.
